name: promptshelf
title: PromptShelf
description: Search, fill and save the prompts in your PromptShelf libraries. Calls the shelf command.
author: your-raycast-username

preferences.name: shelfPath
preferences.title: shelf Command
preferences.description: The full path to the shelf command. Leave empty to look in /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin and ~/.cargo/bin.

preferences.name: workingFolder
preferences.title: Repository Folder
preferences.description: The folder where blanks from the repo (branch, git commands) are read. Defaults to your home folder.
